[[File:Glyph_of_speed.png|thumb|The glyph.]]
The '''Glyph of Speed''' was an ancient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] symbol. According to legend, it had [[Magic/Legends|magical]] properties to it, increasing the speed of Ewoks nearby.

The glyph depicted a curved object and two circles. [[Ewok glyphs]] would often be carved on trees where Ewoks lived.
